questions.question: Why is it important to keep promises?
suggested_answers: It is important to keep promises because it builds trust between people.
Keeping promises shows respect and keeps good relationships.
If you keep your promises, people will trust you and respect you.

questions.question: How do you feel when someone criticises you?
questions.translation: كيف تشعر عندما ينتقدك شخص ما؟
suggested_answers: I feel upset at first, but I try to learn from the criticism.
Sometimes I feel sad or angry, but I take it as useful feedback.
I try to stay calm and think about how I can improve.

questions.question: How do you prefer to communicate with people who live far away?
questions.translation: كيف تفضل التواصل مع الأشخاص الذين يعيشون بعيداً؟
suggested_answers: I prefer to use WhatsApp to call and message them.
I like to use Skype or video calls to see them.
I usually use email or social media to stay in touch.

questions.question: What technology do you use most to contact your family and friends?
questions.translation: ما التكنولوجيا التي تستخدمها أكثر للتواصل مع عائلتك وأصدقائك؟
suggested_answers: I use my phone and WhatsApp most to contact my family and friends.
I use social media and video calls to talk with my friends.
I use the internet and messaging apps to stay in touch.

questions.question: Do you prefer face-to-face communication or using technology? Why?
questions.translation: هل تفضل التواصل المباشر أم استخدام التكنولوجيا؟ لماذا؟
suggested_answers: I prefer face-to-face communication because it is more personal and direct.
I prefer using technology because it is fast and easy, especially with people far away.
I like both, but face-to-face is better for building strong relationships.
